Confirm flange BCD before drilling · Internal inches. Millimetres are interface-only.
Use the P-sheets to cut and drill. D-1…D-12 are overviews. A-sheets are assembly. H-01 is the buy list.
Color: green = plywood structure · tan = solid wood / jigs · silver = hardware · pale = UHMW. Flange bolt circle is ASSUMED until you transfer the part you bought.
